name: year
description: Reference year of the reported research income

name: hep_code
description: Code of the higher education provider assigned by the Department of Education

name: category
description: HERDC research income category, from 1 to 4
observations: 1 Australian competitive grants, 2 other public sector research income, 3 industry and other research income, 4 cooperative research centre income

name: sub_category
description: HERDC research income sub-category within the category
observations: Sub-categories are added and retired over the series; a null amount means the sub-category was not in use that year, which is not the same as a reported nil

name: amount
description: Research income reported for the sub-category
observations: Null where the sub-category was not collected that year
